Actual wall/eave attachment, load/weather, body contact and ordinary contractor/placement/ownership/save remain unverified.

audit.lowerCapScope: 5 actual lower-cap/diagnostic-floor triangle pairs on one existing vertical wood pad, not4feet or actual building mounting. No full surface/stability/load claim.

actualCurvedGussetProfile.scope: 81 actual indexed rounded-rectangle gusset sections and finite centerline turns; not all-continuous curvature, structural strength or load performance

actualPlanarPadCapNormals.scope: Every indexed vertex of both actual coplanar front/back pad cap triangles must agree with that cap geometric normal. Separate cap/bevel shading seam retains smooth rounded edges; not a flatShading-material shortcut or general lighting/continuous surface guarantee.

audit.limits: Selected finite actual triangle/vertex/chord/contact/section probes only. No continuous whole-domain collision/visibility/curvature, measured building/body dimensions, fastening/load/weather physics, actualwall/eave attachment or normal contractor/placement/acquisition/ownership/save. Witnesses and reruns are not unique tests.

compiledWorldPlacement.contactSupportKind: one actual flat lower end cap of the vertical wood mount pad, not four added feet

originalSpriteEnvelopeClearance.method: sphere enclosing all four full raw Sprite quad corners from actual world scale/center; sphere-to-conservative-3D-pose-envelope distance; includes faint/transparent corners without cropping

compiledWorldPlacement.buildingProxyScope: actual current place-group mesh AABBs only; not full building geometry or transparent original-art fixture volume clearance

meadowInstances.scope: every actual current meadow instance geometry AABB transformed by its actual instance and world matrix, expanded .018 in all axes; current finite matrices and authored animation allowance, no all-frame proof

shoreline.method: every actual dry-land boundary segment against entire brace XZ AABB

compiledWorldPlacement.limits: one fixed authored standalone brace pose at one synthetic current-default-world site;5 finite lower-cap/floor triangle pairs on one existing wood pad,63 finite walkability samples and conservative current road, original-card, meadow, shore and building-proxy envelope clearances. These finite witnesses do not verify full lower-cap surface contact, actual wall/eave mounting, support stability, load, physical behavior, body fit, whole-world placement or all-camera visibility

compiledWorldScope: Existing current Scene after synchronous construction/tree-road correction. Node has no DOM or original-art decode; native originalArt-ready Scene/visual views remain separate.
